headings: Standard Operating Procedures - Production Line A
Standard Operating Procedures - Production Line A

relations.subject: RULE-ST01-01
relations.object: FLW MUST be maintained between 112 and 128 L/min

relations.subject: RULE-ST01-02
relations.object: reduce speed by 10% and notify QC

entities.span: PRS drop below 3.3 bar - inspect inlet valve within 5 min.
CUR increase >1.5 A above nominal sustained >5 min - schedule maintenance.

relations.subject: RULE-ST02-03
relations.object: CUR increase >1.5 A above nominal sustained >5 min

relations.subject: RULE-ST02-04
relations.object: CUR drift at ST02_SEALING CORRELATES with speed reduction at ST04_PACKAGING due to shared electrical coupling.

relations.subject: RULE-ST02-04
relations.object: Monitor ST04_PACKAGING-SPD whenever ST02_SEALING-CUR triggers a WARNING

relations.subject: RULE-ST03-01
relations.object: TEN MUST be between 1.8 and 2.6 N

entities.span: CNT below 110 pcs/min - check for label jam

relations.subject: RULE-ST03-02
relations.object: CNT below 110 pcs/min - check for label jam

relations.subject: RULE-ST03-02
relations.object: check for label jam. Below 100 (CRITICAL): halt

entities.span: TEN STUCK >10 consecutive samples - sensor failure

relations.subject: RULE-ST03-03
relations.object: TEN STUCK >10 consecutive samples - sensor failure

entities.span: SPD drops below 1.00 m/s without operator command - verify RULE-ST02-04.

relations.subject: RULE-ST04-03
relations.object: SPD drops below 1.00 m/s without operator command - verify RULE-ST02-04.

relations.subject: RULE-ST04-01
relations.object: MUST remain within normal operating range

entities.span: TMP > 28°C (CRITICAL) - automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes

relations.subject: RULE-SRV01-01
relations.object: automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes

relations.subject: RULE-WRH01-01
relations.object: TMP MUST remain between 0.5°C and 8°C; CRITICAL above 12°C - notify QC and quarantine batch

relations.subject: RULE-01
relations.object: Count WARNING above 5; CRITICAL at max 10

relations.subject: RULE-01
relations.object: Alert safety officer; enforce evacuation if CRITICAL

entities.span: CRITICAL above 25°C - activate emergency ventilation and notify safety officer immediately.

relations.subject: RULE-CHM01-01
relations.object: CRITICAL above 25°C - activate emergency ventilation and notify safety officer immediately.

relations.subject: RULE-CHM01-03
relations.object: Only personnel with hazmat training (technician/supervisor/manager role) are authorised to enter Chemical Storage.

relations.subject: RULE-CHM01-03
relations.object: UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS must be escalated within 2 minutes.

relations.subject: RULE-01
relations.object: Count WARNING above 50 pcs/min; CRITICAL at max 60

relations.subject: RULE-RND01-02
relations.object: HUM drift above 65%RH - activate dehumidifier. Above 75%RH (CRITICAL) - suspend sensitive experiments and inspect HVAC system

entities.span: HUM above 70%RH - inspect drainage and activate ventilation.
